entries.summary: Eight-track arranger for looping techno on M-VAVE's FM1 Open code, with an ARRANGE page of four knob modes (euclidean hits, mutate, swing, dub throw) and a two-tone green phone-style screen.

entries.name: 6210 Drum Peter
entries.summary: 808, 909-style and 303 drum machine for the FM-1 with a TR-style DRUM page (16 step keys, drum pads on the black keys, velocity and chance per step) and panel lights that blink in time; a variant of 3310.

entries.name: AMB-1 Drift
entries.summary: AMB-1 variant that wanders between 24 pieces by itself and adds plucked harp and kalimba, a strings pad, bowed or glass leads, rain, wind, sea and vinyl textures and a reverb shimmer.

entries.name: BRUSSELS
entries.summary: Six-track firmware for the FM-1 from Piknik Elektronik with MS-20-style analog, FM6, lo-fi and drum engines, a 64-step sequencer, hand-drawn Brussels characters that animate with the sound, and a web installer, emulator…

entries.name: DØG-5
entries.summary: Aggressive eight-voice virtual-analog synth with a four-stage Psych Chain, 99 program slots and a pixel-art dog scene on screen; a fork of OberVave for the band DØGS.

entries.name: Dusk
entries.summary: Lofi beat maker for the FM-1: four tracks of keys, bass, drums and lead built from clips, four scenes per tape, a song page and tape effects such as wobble, vinyl crackle and rain.

entries.name: ENTROPY HELIOS
entries.summary: Ambient drone and microtonal synth for the FM-1 with a generative ENTROPY mode and a hands-on PURE HW mode, two-core voices, 16 stackable effect cartridges and a browser installer and studio page.

entries.name: FM1-Drydock
entries.summary: Standalone firmware loader that turns a Waveshare ESP32-S3 AMOLED touch board into a USB-C cartridge holding several FM-1 firmware packages, with a PC sync tool, a restore to M-VAVE's V15 and a rescue mode for an FM-1 t…

entries.name: FM-1 Flasher (ashtonwallen)
entries.summary: Windows script around M-Flasher that picks a firmware from a checked list, verifies its SHA-256 and the flash chip, backs up the whole flash, writes and verifies the package, and sets up USB audio.

entries.name: FM-1 Vibe Kit
entries.summary: Command-line development kit for macOS that sets up a container with the JieLi toolchain and SDK pinned by checksum, then builds, tests, fuzzes, flashes and inspects crashes of FM-1 firmware projects.

entries.name: FM1amp
entries.summary: Windows app in the style of Winamp that keeps several FM-1 firmwares on one unit and switches between them, saving and restoring each one's projects and settings as a snapshot.

entries.name: FREITAKT
entries.summary: Hortator fork with a Model:Cycles-style workflow: six tracks of drum and synth machines plus a chord machine, free polymeter, parameter and machine locks, per-track arpeggio and retrigger, patterns with chains and MIDI…

entries.name: Frodhes-Bark
entries.summary: Fork of Frodhes that adds physically modelled Wurlitzer 140B and 200A reeds, recalibrated Rhodes bark, stereo effects and a six-point velocity curve editor, with date-numbered builds for the FM-1, SMK-37 and Akai MPC.

entries.name: GABBERKIX
entries.summary: Hardcore kick designer: a synthesized 909 through two EQ and distortion stages, a punch layer and a sub, with a randomizer, 16 presets, resampling and MIDI clock.

entries.name: GARDEN
entries.summary: Self-playing ambient firmware for the FM-1 where each key plants a melody seed that sprouts, grows a phrase, flowers with bells, seeds and withers, tended by a gardener with bees, a rabbit and weather.

entries.name: GLORY PAD
entries.summary: Worship-style ambient pad for the FM-1: hold a key for a six-voice pad with 20 presets, open, major or minor chords, octave shimmer, chorus and a long reverb, written as one C file on the foma template.

entries.name: GWAAN-1
entries.summary: Generative ambient drone firmware for the FM-1 that plays itself from power-on, with four layers, five scenes, a live mixer page, arpeggiator, freeze, snapshots and USB MIDI control.

entries.name: HamsterSynth
entries.summary: Port of the author's Hamster Piano web page: eight pixel-art hamsters sing the white keys, with a 16-step sequencer of eight patterns, a song mode and drums. The README is in Norwegian.

entries.name: JT-80x0
entries.summary: Virtual analog synth that ports the author's JT-8000, a JP-8000-style engine, to the FM-1 in fixed point: Super Saw, a JP-style filter, multi-effects, delay, plate reverb, arpeggiator, two-track sequencer, split and dua…

entries.name: Mariotronics
entries.summary: Guitar and piano instrument for the FM-1 built around a shared tape loop with overdubbing, reverse playback and a 64-preset bank, in the manner of Frippertronics and Eno's tape pieces, installed from a standalone editor…

entries.name: MONASTERY
entries.summary: Self-playing ambient firmware for the FM-1 in which seven monks chant the hours over a drone in a stone chapel, with a bell for each office and a novice, an abbot and a brother who sings flat.

entries.name: FM-1 MusiCraft
entries.summary: Voxel world you walk through in first person, with four 16-step sequencers built into the landscape whose volume falls off with distance.

entries.name: Nano Freak
entries.summary: uFreak-style synth with fifteen oscillator types, a state-variable or ladder filter, two LFOs, a five-source modulation matrix, a stereo widener, an arpeggiator and a 64-step sequencer; a fork of FMini-1.

entries.name: NIGHT TRAIN
entries.summary: Self-playing ambient firmware for the FM-1 that rides an endless night train through generated landscapes and stations, with the wheel clacks as the beat and six regulars whose stories continue over many nights.

entries.name: POND (ashtonwallen)
entries.summary: Self-playing ambient firmware for the FM-1 set in a pond of named fish that each sing a note, with seasons, friendships, a visiting heron and keys that drop food.

entries.name: PROPHET 67
entries.summary: Seven-voice analogue-style polysynth after the Sequential Prophet-6, with poly mod, per-voice vintage drift, voice spread, effects, a low split, aftertouch and a four-track sequencer.

entries.name: Shortwave
entries.summary: Fictional ambient radio for the FM-1 with four continuously playing stations on a simulated 5 to 15 MHz dial, where tuning between them blends the music with static and pitch drift.

entries.name: Solinaesque
entries.summary: Paraphonic divide-down string machine with 16', 8' and 4' registers, a shared filter and envelope, ensemble, flanger, delay and reverb, an arpeggiator and chord memory.

entries.name: STRABBLEDROME
entries.summary: Experimental firmware that holds STRATA, PALINDROME and BabbleBeat in one install, switched from a menu opened with GLO.

entries.name: TAVERN
entries.summary: Self-playing folk-session firmware for the FM-1 where eight regulars drift into a tavern, play generated reels, jigs and airs on fiddles, whistle, harp, lute, box, bass and bodhran, quarrel and leave at closing.

entries.name: Telegram 101
entries.summary: A 101-style lead, Dillo acid bass and synthesized 808 drums on the FM-1, with Band arrangements that play all three from the keys and one-bar knob-motion recording.

entries.name: Tide Clock
entries.summary: Ambient firmware for the FM-1 whose music follows the time of day, with a pixel-art coast showing sun and moon, tides, boats, gulls, weather and a lighthouse keeper called Abel.

entries.name: Tinsel
entries.summary: Christmas music toys and games for children and adults: a tree with a bauble above every key, a carol book, an Advent calendar, a music box, change-ringing bells and small two-player games.

entries.name: Zodiac
entries.summary: Self-playing ambient firmware with twelve zodiac signs, each a moving picture and a piece of music that changes by itself, with a browser installer and emulator.

entries.name: better-smc-mixer
entries.summary: Alternative firmware for the SMC-Mixer that runs beside M-VAVE's own and turns its faders, encoders and buttons into a configurable MIDI controller, installed and edited from a browser page.

entries.name: PC Cardputer-Adv MIDI Player
entries.summary: PlatformIO firmware that makes the Cardputer-Adv an eight-voice sine-wave synth played live by MIDI bytes sent from a computer over the USB serial port.

entries.name: smpltrek-loopstart
entries.summary: Work-in-progress patch for SmplTrek system 3.2.174 that makes the loop clip START POS page move in beats and bars and adds a scene-wide shift; the update file is built locally from the user's own official SmplTrek.bin.

Pre-release. Adds realtime insert effects on tracks, synth parts and the master with meters and EQ graphs, the MONO, PRISM, GRIT, HARM, PHASE and POLY synth engines with 72 factory patches, synth randomise on Shift + F7…

Adds a USB DRIVE mode that shows the SD card to a computer and USB audio in and out with no driver, plus battery support, SYNC polarity settings and more UI toolkit parts. USB drive, audio and MIDI were tested on a Smpl…

Pre-release, the hardware update. The OP-1 acts as a USB host for one device at a time: a class-compliant MIDI keyboard, a FAT32 flash drive whose sounds and kits show in the preset browser, or a mouse. Adds whole-OP-1…

Windows test build, marked as a pre-release and not signed; ships as a setup program and a zip, finds the OP-Z over USB-C and pairs it over Bluetooth. Installing Galax-z OS from Windows has not been tried on an OP-Z.

Android test build, marked as a pre-release and signed with a test key; an APK for Android 11 or newer that connects over Bluetooth or USB-C. Galax-z OS is installed from the Mac app, not from Android.

releases.notes: GRDLOOP returns to its earlier 31,394-byte size, which v2.0.4 had grown past what the pedal is known to load; sound and knobs are unchanged.
